title: Falling Under the Power of God to Rise in Your Calling
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner on this powerful sermon as he shares the transformative experience of falling under the power of God, and how it can lead to a life-changing encounter with the Holy Spirit. Learn from the story of Saul's radical transformation in Acts chapter 9 and discover how to rise in your calling by surrendering to the power of God. This episode is a must-listen for anyone seeking a deeper connection with God and a fresh anointing for their life's purpose.
